title: Coast Guard rescues 2 people from sailing vessel beset by water near 57 miles of Apalachicola
description: An Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew hoists two mariners from a 42-foot sailing vessel beset by weather 57 miles of Apalachicola Jan.16, 2022. the two boaters were safely transferred to Air Station Clearwater with no medical concerns. (U.S. Coast Guard photo)
